_why: MINIMAL VALID create body for BankQuestion.
BankQuestionRepository.UpsertAsync hard-rejects a null Question, so a real QuestionDto is
required. QuestionDto is JSON-polymorphic on a 'type' discriminator (QuestionDto.cs:12-26);
'text' is the simplest concrete type. Title is a LocalizedString - a locale-keyed map that
must contain at least one non-empty locale (LocalizedStringValidator).
TRAP3-WRITE PROBE: locked is documented 'Read-only from client - server flips to true on
first publish reference' and is ignored on the reverse map (GeneralMappingProfile.cs:75).
Sending true on create must NOT stick: the readback should show locked=false. If it shows
true, client input has overwritten a server-controlled column.
bankEntryID is deliberately omitted - it is server-assigned on create, and the conditional
map guards it so an absent field cannot clobber the entity's Guid.NewGuid() default.
